verdicts.title: Schur multipliers of special p-groups of rank 2
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A group G is called special p-group of rank k if the commutator subgroup [G,G] and centre Z(G) are equal, which is elementary abelian p-group of rank k and G/[G,G] is also elementary abelian p-group. In this article we determine the Schur multiplier of special p-groups of rank 2 explicitly.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses special p-groups and Schur multipliers, which does not interact with the specific claim about Coxeter group rank and monomial ideal complexity, despite both being related to group theory.

verdicts.title: The central tree property and algorithmic problems on subgroups of free groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the average case complexity of the uniform membership problem for subgroups of free groups, and we show that it is orders of magnitude smaller than the worst case complexity of the best known algorithms. This applies to subgroups given by a fixed number of generators as well as to subgroups given by an exponential number of generators.
